# Successful mixed monetary survivor run, 2026-09-11

The fresh 2 minimint-ng + 2 reference federation completed all four monetary survivor/restart cases. Each case has a separately passed certificate, Bitcoin witness, confirmed-block, state-equality and restored-Mint-share gate. The terminal process invocation passed in 1219.20 seconds and joined all guardians; reference exit 255 is recorded without calling it a clean exit.

`completion/` preserves the public final histories, Wallet replies, exact invocation, artifact identities and observed cleanup. The driver monetary_workflow flag remains false; independently verified captures establish the monetary claims. Raw client state, tokens and credentials are excluded. A credential filename in the invocation is not its contents.

This evidence does not establish complete native API conformance, client inventory possession, Bitcoin chain selection, host power-loss durability or production readiness. The earlier failed federation and its partial case3 remain in separate fixture roots.
